page.overview:
Who is Vinegar Doppio?

Doppio is The Boss' younger, more innocent and eccentric underboss. As a member of Passione, he thinks of himself as the most loyal subordinate to Diavolo, but in reality, the two are separate souls inhabiting the same body.

During the course of Vento Aureo, he helps Diavolo to act and move around undetected.

It is ambiguous whether Doppio is truly a natural Stand User, but he is able to partially wield King Crimson in battle with Diavolo's permission.

Doppio appears as a fairly slim yet fit young man; described as "too young" to have a 15 year old daughter. He has freckles, contributing to his youthful look, and light-colored irises that disappear when he is not in control of the body. His hair is tied into a neck-length ponytail by a weave-like braid; the front hair is left loose and sweeps over to one side lock, the position and length of which is portrayed inconsistently.
